answer: Cross-epoch reputation carryover. Each epoch the agent derives its reputation score in part from an unpredictable seeding input (a nebula-derived random challenge) it must answer consistently with prior epochs; a fable of its past actions is reconstructed and scored for behavioural agreement across epochs. Agents whose reconstructed behaviour diverges pay a dune of escalating reputational penalties: their score decays with each inconsistency, shrinking vote weight and access.
